retry.fallbackChains.label: Retry Fallback Chains

Model-oriented keys apply whenever that model/provider is active, regardless of role; a "provider/*" entry keeps the failing model's id and swaps the provider. An id-prefixed wildcard ("openrouter/google/*") re-prefixes the failing model's bare id (google-antigravity/gemini-x -> openrouter/google/gemini-x) and, used as a key, matches only that provider's ids under the prefix. A fallback entry may carry an explicit thinking suffix ("provider/model:low", ":high", ":max", ":off"); a bare entry inherits the failing turn's effort, and "provider/*" entries always inherit.

hindsight.autoRecall.description: 在新会话首次提问时自动检索并注入相关的持久记忆知识

hindsight.autoRetain.label: 定期沉淀转录记录至记忆
hindsight.autoRetain.description: 每隔指定轮次以及会话结束时自动沉淀上下文记忆

hindsight.mentalModelAutoSeed.label: 自动播种默认心智模型
hindsight.mentalModelAutoSeed.description: 会话启动时自动补齐缺失的项目规范、技术选型默认心智模型

ttsr.builtinRules.description: 自动加载随安装包附带的基础安全与行为修正规则

edit.fuzzyThreshold.label: 模糊匹配相似度阈值

edit.streamingAbort.label: 补丁预览失败立即中止

edit.recoverInlineEdits.label: 内联代码块自动转为编辑

edit.enforceSeenLines.label: 严格校验锚定行是否已读
edit.enforceSeenLines.description: 拒绝锚定在先前 read/grep 未曾完整展示过的代码行上的修改

edit.blackbox.enabled.label: Record Parse Regressions
edit.blackbox.enabled.description: Append full before/after source when an edit introduces an AST parse failure

edit.autoRepair.enabled.label: 代码语法错误自动修复
edit.autoRepair.enabled.description: 当修改导致 AST 解析失败时让小模型自动修复破坏的语法区间

plan.enabled.label: 只读架构规划模式 (Plan Mode)
